The main takeaway from our work is that
DFMs provide a framework for designing neural network layers that can act on spaces with arbitrary (possibly infinite dimension) and can express a variety of topologies.
DFMs provide a new way to express neural network layer topologies that are not limited to the Euclidean setting.
DFMs can be used to design neural networks that can learn invariances and other topological features of data, which is a step forward towards building more robust and interpretable models.
